name: Cape EMS Berhad
overview: 2026年，Cape EMS 通过 Cape Renewables 收购 Cape Wibawa (Sarawak) 70% 股权，扩展可再生能源业务；同时完成私下配售并拟发行 5,000 万令吉 RCPS 筹资。此外，公司就飞机合作项目与 Aeronas 等方进入法律程序。
overview_en: In 2026, Cape EMS acquired a 70% stake in Cape Wibawa (Sarawak) via Cape Renewables to expand its renewable energy business, completed a private placement, and proposed a RM50 million RCPS issue. The company also entered legal proceedings with Aeronas and others over an aircraft collaboration.

segments.name: 可再生能源
segments.note: 通过 Cape Renewables 收购 Cape Wibawa (Sarawak) 70% 股权，扩展可再生能源业务。
segments.note_en: Expanded renewable energy business through Cape Renewables' acquisition of a 70% stake in Cape Wibawa (Sarawak).

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: Cape Renewables 以 70,000 令吉现金收购 Cape Wibawa (Sarawak) 70% 股权。
actions.text_en: Cape Renewables acquired a 70% equity interest in Cape Wibawa (Sarawak) for RM70,000 cash.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 完成私下配售并拟发行 RCPS 筹资；就飞机合作项目进入法律程序。
segments.note_en: Completed a private placement and proposed an RCPS issue for fundraising; entered legal proceedings over an aircraft collaboration.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 私下配售完成，第三批 8,803,851 股配售股于 2026 年 10 月 27 日上市。
actions.text_en: The private placement was completed with the listing of 8,803,851 placement shares, the third and final tranche, on 27 October 2026.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 与 Pro3C (Malaysia) Sdn Bhd 签订有条件认购协议，拟发行 50,000,000 股 RCPS，发行价每股 1.00 令吉，总值 5,000 万令吉。
actions.text_en: Entered a conditional subscription agreement with Pro3C (Malaysia) Sdn Bhd for the proposed issuance of 50,000,000 RCPS at RM1.00 each, totaling RM50 million.

actions.title: CAPE EMS BERHAD ("CEB" OR "THE COMPANY") - LEGAL PROCEEDINGS BETWEEN CAPE MANUFACTURING (M) SDN. BHD. (A WHOLLY OWNED SUBSIDIARY OF THE COMP
actions.text: 全资子公司 Cape Manufacturing (M) Sdn Bhd 与 Aeronas Aerocraft Sdn Bhd 等四方就拟议飞机制造合作项目进入法律程序。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Cape Manufacturing (M) Sdn Bhd entered legal proceedings with Aeronas Aerocraft Sdn Bhd and four others arising from a proposed aircraft manufacturing collaboration.
